verdict.rationale: There are indirect signs of API versioning. Package docs are version-pinned (com.unity.ai.assistant@2.20, com.unity.ai.inference@2.4), the UPM registry exposes versioned package releases such as 2.20.0-pre.1, and the docs explicitly mark the in-editor MCP server as deprecated in favor of the CLI. However, nothing in the evidence describes a formal deprecation policy or versioning guarantees. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/support-window policy, explicit API versioning and compatibility guarantees for the scripting APIs, migration guidance, and independent corroboration.
